cohort: 954 infertile women with one previous delivery undergoing in vitro fertilization
finding: While previous cesarean section was associated with reduced pregnancy and live birth rates after in vitro fertilization, the presence of uterine scar diverticulum did not significantly impact pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that women with a previous cesarean section had lower live birth, clinical pregnancy, and embryo implantation rates after in vitro fertilization compared to women with a previous vaginal delivery.
